topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
consensus_response: The 45° scan range impacts link budgets by increasing interference and reducing achievable signal strength.  Broadside beams, with their wider beam coverage, provide higher SNR but require precise pointing. This tradeoff affects user densities at the edge of coverage. Multipath propagation further complicates calculations due to increased interference, necessitating sophisticated MUD algorithms for optimal performance.
